snippet.title: Chess Club - Official PS VR2 Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Watch the PS VR2 Release Date Trailer for Chess Club, a VR chess game developed by Odders Lab. Players will face off against friends or play solo across four environments to reign victorious over the classic game of chess. Track move history across multiple games, engage with casual and ranked matches, and more to build up an ELO unlike any other. Chess Club is launching on July 18 for PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2).
